text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower gave it her all, and on the 
grand stage of the Japanese Derby, she 
caught up to Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Rice Shower did not let her guard 
down, thinking she might have won just by 
chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to challenge Mihono Bourbon once 
more, Rice Shower's next target is the 
long-distance race: the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Rice Shower, a true stayer, the days 
leading up to her defining race have 
begun.
